title: 第4章 天秀惨变
content_zh:
“事情原来是这样。”易若晨怒视着唐风，娇叱道：“唐风你有何话说？”

林若鸢急忙道：“唐风不是这样的人！”

易若晨冷冷一笑：“知人知面不知心！男人大了，什么事都干得出来，你还当他是小孩子？”

“唐风是我一手带大的，我了解他的为人！他可能胆子小了点，性格弱了点，但是绝对不会做出这等无耻的事情！”林若鸢也毫不示弱，据理力争。

正在此时，一阵啪啪的声音传了过来，不紧不慢，一声接着一声，如同铜锤一般敲打在众人的心头上。

等众人转过头去，正看到唐风躺在床上，脸上挂着似是而非的笑容，轻轻抚掌。

“你这是什么意思？”易若晨冷冷地看着唐风。

“混淆视听，颠倒是非，扭曲事实，把黑的说成白的！秦小婉你好样的！这个借口在你来之前就应该想好了吧？或者，并不是你想的，是有人告诉你的？不过我总算明白一句话的意思了。”

秦小婉身体一抖，根本不敢正眼去看唐风。这个杀人的借口确实是有人提点过她。

唐风冷冷地扫过易若晨和秦小婉，低沉道：“毒蛇口中牙，黄蜂尾后针，二者皆不毒，最毒妇人心！”

“唐风你有话直说！”白素衣也觉得这件事大有蹊跷，并不象表面看起来这么简单，当然不能听信秦小婉的一面之辞。

“那就我放开胆子说了。”唐风端坐了身姿，也不再客气，“她秦小婉是什么实力？如果我没记错的话，她身为内宗核心弟子，应该已经到了炼罡六品的境界了吧？我唐风是什么实力？说好听点，炼罡一品，说难听点，屁都不是。试问，我能对她用强么？她一根手指头就能把我从天秀这头戳到那头！”

满屋的人都思考了起来，唐风说的话是事实，能成为天秀内宗核心弟子，实力自然不会太差，怎么会被一个一点实力都没的人用强呢。

“好吧，就算我真的用强了，你秦小婉直接打昏我就行了。有必要动刀动剑么？”

“我……”秦小婉依然在瑟瑟发抖，我了半天终于想起什么，赶紧说道：“我当时心慌意乱，顾不得那么多了。”

“然后正好刺在我胸口的位置？”唐风扯开上衣，露出胸口那条长长的剑伤，这种致命的位置，怎么会在无意中刺上？若说是巧合也有可能，但是这个可能性显然不大。

不给秦小婉狡辩的机会，唐风接着说道：“你平时对我根本不假辞色，今日又如何会好心来探望我？白天我无故昏迷，你就趁机来取我性命！而且选的正是胸口这个致命位置，是也不是？”

最后一声爆喝，让秦小婉手足无措，脸上心虚之意显而易见。

“若不是我命大，被疼痛刺激醒来，现在恐怕要被你秦小婉泼一身脏水了，到时候谁来跟你争辩！秦小婉你记住，我唐风就算真的要找女人，也不会找你这种肮脏的贱人！”

“好了。”听到唐风骂得如此难听，白素衣也有些挂不住脸面了，“事情我了解了个大概，是非曲直自有公论，这件事待我和几位长老商议后再做决定。”

今天这件事疑点太多。如果事情真的如唐风所说，那么秦小婉最后为什么没能得手？还陷入了那种恐惧的状态中？秦小婉又为什么要杀唐风？

“你们都散了吧，唐风你好好养伤，另外，传莫丫头过来给唐风治疗一下。”白素衣挥挥手道。

一帮三代弟子在宗主和长老们的带领下，依次走出门外。

秦小婉临走之际，回头看了唐风一眼。她在刺杀唐风之前，曾今说过一些不为人知的秘密。刚才她也怕唐风把自己的秘密抖露出来，可是唐风没有。秦小婉还以为唐风那时候在昏迷中并没有听到。

但是当回头看这一眼的时候，秦小婉分明看到唐风嘴角挂着一抹嘲讽的微笑，嘴唇微微蠕动了两下。

孩子！秦小婉脸色大变，跌跌撞撞冲出门外！

他听到了，可是他刚才为什么不说出来？如果唐风说出她有孩子的事情，那么自己绝对死无葬身之地。天秀门规在哪摆着，更有前车之鉴，容不得自己反抗。一想起这些，秦小婉就心乱如麻。

天秀宗大殿之中，白素衣和四大长老端坐在内，沉默半晌，白素衣才开口道：“今天这事，你们如何看待？”

易若晨自然是维护自己的弟子，站起身道：“分明就是唐风见色心起，否则以小婉的秉性和脾气哪会刺他一剑？”

林若鸢冷哼道：“我不管这事是谁对谁错。但是风儿是那个女人的孩子！那个女人的手段如何，你们想必都清楚。当年她不杀你们，已经是顾及同门之谊，想为天秀留点根基。今天风儿幸亏没死，若是真的死了，整个天秀就等着给风儿陪葬吧！”

听到林若鸢说起那个女人，在座的几个女子都脸色微变。十几年前的天秀惨变，她们也亲身经历过，见识过那个女人的手段。当时那个女人还有孕在身，一柄长剑杀得整个天秀鸡飞狗跳，血流成河，无数弟子横尸当场！

六个月后，唐风被送到了天秀宗，指名要林若鸢抚养，为期十六年。

“林若鸢你提那个女人干什么？”易若晨脸色讪讪。

“我没想干什么。”林若鸢幽幽道，“十六年，还剩下最后一年了。只要风儿离开了天秀，到时候是生是死她也不会责怪到我们头上。”

说着说着，林若鸢眼圈微红，离开了天秀，风儿也不知道该如何生活，以他的性格，在这个世界上根本存活不下来。

“我只希望，在这最后一年，任何人都不要对风儿下手！”林若鸢抛下这句话，大步走出了门外。

白素衣揉了揉额头道：“先将小婉看管起来吧，今天唐风话里话外都意有所指，我需要查探清楚其中是不是有什么内幕。另外传令下，今天这事谁都不许外传，违者门规处置。”
content_en:
"So that's what happened." Yi Ruochen glared at Tang Feng and scolded, "Tang Feng, what do you have to say?"

Lin Ruoyuan said hurriedly: "Tang Feng is not such a person!"

Yi Ruochen smiled coldly: "You know people, you know faces, but you don't know hearts! When a man is grown, he can do anything, and you still treat him like a child?"

"Tang Feng was brought up by me, and I know what he is like! He may be a little timid and has a weak personality, but he will never do such a shameless thing!" Lin Ruoyuan did not show any weakness and argued with reason.

At this moment, a burst of snapping sounds came over, one after another, like a copper hammer, hitting everyone's hearts.

When everyone turned their heads, they saw Tang Feng lying on the bed with a specious smile on his face and gently stroking his hands.

"What do you mean?" Yi Ruochen looked at Tang Feng coldly.

"Confuse the public, confuse right and wrong, distort facts, and turn black into white! Well done to you, Qin Xiaowan! You should have thought of this excuse before you came here, right? Or is it not what you thought, but someone told you? But I finally understand the meaning of the sentence. "

Qin Xiaowan trembled and did not dare to look at Tang Feng.This excuse for killing was indeed something someone had mentioned to her.

Tang Feng glanced at Yi Ruochen and Qin Xiaowan coldly and said in a low voice: "The teeth in the mouth of a poisonous snake and the needle in the back of a wasp's tail are not poisonous, but they are the most poisonous to women's hearts!"

"Tang Feng, just say it!" Bai Suyi also felt that there was something fishy about this matter. It was not as simple as it seemed on the surface. Of course, she couldn't believe Qin Xiaowan's words.

"Then let me speak boldly." Tang Feng sat up straight and was no longer polite, "What kind of strength is Qin Xiaowan? If I remember correctly, as a core disciple of the Inner Sect, she should have reached the sixth level of Refining the Gang.What kind of strength is I, Tang Feng?To put it mildly, I am a level one, and to put it harshly, I am not a person.Can I use force against her?She can poke me from one end to the other with just one finger!

Everyone in the room began to think. What Tang Feng said was true. If he could become a core disciple of Tianxiu Inner Sect, his strength would not be too bad. How could he be used by someone with no strength at all?

"Okay, even if I really use force, you Qin Xiaowan can just knock me unconscious. Is it necessary to use a sword?"

"I..." Qin Xiaowan was still trembling. It took me a long time to finally think of something and said quickly: "I was so flustered that I couldn't care less."

"Then it happened to stab my chest?" Tang Feng pulled open his shirt, revealing the long sword wound on his chest. How could he accidentally stab me in such a fatal position?It is possible that it is a coincidence, but this possibility is obviously unlikely.

Without giving Qin Xiaowan a chance to quibble, Tang Feng continued: "You usually don't treat me hypocritically, so how could you be kind enough to visit me today? I was unconscious for no reason during the day, and you took the opportunity to take my life! And you chose the fatal spot on the chest, right?"

The last loud shout left Qin Xiaowan at a loss, and the guilty conscience was obvious on her face.

"If I hadn't been lucky enough to wake up from the pain, I would have been splashed with dirty water by you Qin Xiaowan. Who will argue with you then? Qin Xiaowan, remember, even if I, Tang Feng, really want to find a woman, I will not look for a dirty bitch like you!"

"Okay." Hearing Tang Feng's scolding, Bai Suyi felt a little embarrassed, "I have a rough understanding of the matter. The merits of the matter have their own merits. I will make a decision on this matter after discussing it with several elders."

There are too many doubts about this matter today.If things were really as Tang Feng said, then why didn't Qin Xiaowan succeed in the end?Still stuck in that state of fear?Why did Qin Xiaowan want to kill Tang Feng?

"You all should disperse. Tang Feng, please take good care of your injuries. In addition, send Mo Yatou over to give Tang Feng some treatment." Bai Suyi waved her hand.

A group of third-generation disciples, led by the sect master and elders, walked out of the door one after another.

Before Qin Xiaowan left, she looked back at Tang Feng.Before she assassinated Tang Feng, Zeng Jin told some unknown secrets.Just now she was afraid that Tang Feng would reveal his secret, but Tang Feng didn't.Qin Xiaowan thought Tang Feng didn't hear it when he was in a coma.

But when she looked back, Qin Xiaowan clearly saw a mocking smile hanging on the corner of Tang Feng's mouth, and her lips twitched slightly.

child!Qin Xiaowan's face changed drastically and she stumbled out of the door!

He heard it, but why didn't he say it just now?If Tang Feng revealed that she had a child, he would definitely die without a burial place.Wherever Tianxiu's sect rules are laid out, there are lessons learned from the past, and he cannot allow himself to resist.Thinking of these, Qin Xiaowan felt confused.

In the main hall of Tianxiu Sect, Bai Suyi and the four elders sat in silence for a long time before Bai Suyi said, "What do you think of today's matter?"

Yi Ruochen naturally defended his disciples and stood up and said: "It's obvious that Tang Feng is lustful, otherwise how could Xiao Wan stab him with his nature and temper?"

Lin Ruoyuan snorted coldly: "I don't care who is right or wrong in this matter. But Feng'er is that woman's child! You must all know what that woman's methods are. When she didn't kill you, she was already considering the friendship of the same family and wanted to leave some foundation for Tianxiu. Fortunately, Feng'er did not die today. If he really died, the entire Tianxiu would be buried with Feng'er!"

Hearing Lin Ruoyuan talk about that woman, the faces of the women present changed slightly.They had also personally experienced the Tianxiu tragedy more than ten years ago, and had seen that woman's methods.That woman was still pregnant at the time, and she killed the whole Tianxiu with a long sword, causing blood to flow into rivers, and countless disciples lay dead on the spot!

Six months later, Tang Feng was sent to Tianxiu Sect and named to be raised by Lin Ruoyuan for a period of sixteen years.

"Lin Ruoyuan, why are you mentioning that woman?" Yi Ruochen's face was stern.

"I didn't want to do anything." Lin Ruoyuan said quietly, "Sixteen years, there is still the last year left. As long as Feng'er leaves Tianxiu, she will not blame us for life or death."

As she spoke, Lin Ruoyuan's eyes turned red, and she left Tianxiu. Feng'er didn't know how to live. With his character, he simply couldn't survive in this world.

"I just hope that in this last year, no one will do anything to Feng'er!" Lin Ruoyuan dropped these words and strode out of the door.

Bai Suyi rubbed her forehead and said, "Let's take Xiao Wan into custody first. Tang Feng's words today are all full of meaning. I need to find out if there is any inside story. In addition, we have issued an order that no one is allowed to spread the word about this matter today. Violators will be punished according to the sect rules."
